Current KQM library material supports Hexerei-enhanced Razor and C6 synergy with Durin while retaining long-field-time specialization.
Current Cryo Traveler guide supports Stellar-Conduct/Stellar-Swirl use while noting C0 uptime and sub-DPS limitations.
Current guide supports major Hexerei value while retaining boss/control limitations and dependence on current Hexerei cores for peak performance.
Current guide supports strong Stellar-Swirl DPS at C0 with accessible weapon/team options while overlapping with other Stellar-Swirl carries.
Current guide supports wide team coverage, healing, interruption resistance, low field time and no Burst reliance, while documenting possible Hydro interference in some Stellar-Swirl teams.
Current guide supports Yae Miko as a premier Stellar-Conduct Electro option while the archetype remains the main source of her near-S current value.
